Andaman and Nicobar Islands.notes: Capital Port Blair officially renamed Sri Vijaya Puram on 2024-09-13; the DISTRICT is still South Andaman. Accept both as synonyms. Pre-2006 records say just 'Andaman'.

Andhra Pradesh.disagreement: My brief said 26 and was WRONG - that is the Apr 2022 figure. Stale LGD/census datasets still show 26. No renames in the Dec 2025 reorganisation.

Arunachal Pradesh.disagreement: Some Feb 2024 reports say 28; that counts the Itanagar Capital Complex, which has a DC but is NOT a revenue district. Excluding it gives 27.

Assam.disagreement: assam.gov.in still lists 'Karimganj' (stale name, correct count). Assam also has a sub-district 'co-district' tier (47-49 by Aug 2026) frequently miscounted as districts - revenue districts remain 35.

Bihar.disagreement: Gaya renamed 'Gaya Ji' by cabinet May 2025 and gaya.nic.in brands itself GAYA JI, but Wikipedia/LGD still use 'Gaya'. Kept Gaya canonical, Gaya Ji as alias - flag for product decision. LGD uses Purbi/Pashchim Champaran where Wikipedia uses East/West.

Chandigarh.notes: Single-district UT; auto-select once Chandigarh is chosen. Mohali (Punjab) and Panchkula (Haryana) must NOT be offered under it.

Chhattisgarh.disagreement: Systematic canonical-spelling conflict: LGD uses Dakshin Bastar Dantewada / Uttar Bastar Kanker / Kabeerdham / Korea / Gariyaband; Wikipedia uses the short forms. Wikipedia forms kept canonical, LGD forms as aliases.

Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.disagreement: One Wikipedia district page claims 4; that is an internal inconsistency with no notification behind it. ddd.gov.in lists exactly 3 Collectors.
Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.notes: Legacy records use the two pre-2020 UT names as STATE values - both must be accepted as synonyms of the merged UT at state level.

Delhi.disagreement: My brief said 11 and was WRONG. revenue.delhi.gov.in states 13 revenue districts since 2026-01-01 (Cabinet 2025-12-11). Shahdara was DISSOLVED; Old Delhi, Central North and Outer North created. Addresses stored under the old 11-district scheme need remapping. Shahdara kept as an alias of North East Delhi, which holds its sub-division.

Goa.disagreement: Goa had 2 for decades; Kushavati (HQ Quepem) notified 2025-12-31 but NOT yet operational - offices still at Margao as of Jan 2026. Most datasets still show 2 or label it proposed. Expect user data to still say South Goa for its talukas.

Gujarat.disagreement: Third-party lists still say 33 (pre-Oct-2025). Gazette GHM/2025/210/M/RD/RCO notified 24 Sep 2025, effective 2 Oct 2025.

Haryana.disagreement: haryana.gov.in 'At A Glance' still shows 22 (stale). hansi.haryana.gov.in is live.

Jammu and Kashmir.disagreement: Leh and Kargil correctly EXCLUDED - separate UT of Ladakh. A 2026 reorganisation bill proposing ~10 more districts is pending, not enacted.

Karnataka.disagreement: Two NAMES unsettled: Ramanagara's NIC site migrated to bengalurusouth.nic.in (rename effective 2025-05-23) but state portal still says Ramanagara; Bengaluru Rural to Bengaluru North cabinet-approved 2025-07-02 with no gazette found. State-portal spellings kept canonical, new names as aliases.

Ladakh.disagreement: My brief said 2 and was WRONG. 5 new districts announced Aug 2024 but gazette-notified 2026-04-27 (Nubra, Sham, Changthang, Zanskar, Drass) = 7; Sankoo notified 2026-10-16 = 8. Pre-Apr-2026 sources say 2; Apr-Oct 2026 sources say 7. Census 2011 and most aggregators still say 2.
Ladakh.notes: New districts notified but not yet operational - postal addresses in these areas still read Leh or Kargil, so the dropdown must keep accepting the parent district.

Lakshadweep.notes: Uni-district UT. The 10 inhabited islands should be offered at city level since the district carries no information: Kavaratti, Agatti, Amini, Andrott, Bitra, Chetlat, Kadmat, Kalpeni, Kiltan, Minicoy.

Madhya Pradesh.as_of: 2023 additions (Mauganj, Pandhurna, Maihar); frozen to 2027-03-31 for census
Madhya Pradesh.disagreement: Wikipedia + NIC directory give 55. Some aggregators say 57, counting never-operationalised Chachaura and Nagda (cabinet-approved 2020) or merely proposed Bina/Junnardeo. Older pages say 52. News numbering of the 2023 districts is inconsistent.

Maharashtra.as_of: renames of 2023-10-11 and 2024-10-04; no new district since Palghar 2014
Maharashtra.disagreement: 36 districts, matching https://www.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/1529/Districts. Ahilyanagar is the legal DISTRICT name: Revenue & Forests notification TLC-2024/C.R.146/M-10 of 8 Oct 2024, recited in the Maharashtra Gazette Extraordinary of 13 Mar 2025, renamed the district and taluka, and the Zilla Parishad was renamed on that basis. Ahmednagar is an alias only. Bare 'Mumbai'/'Bombay' are not aliases of either Mumbai district: they name both, and the search offers both.

Manipur.disagreement: Several Manipur departmental sites still say 9, quoting 2001/2011 census text. State portal names exactly these 16.

Meghalaya.disagreement: A separate Shillong district was still only under review in the Feb 2026 Budget Session - not a 13th district.

Mizoram.disagreement: CAG audit report and NABARD/NEDFI papers independently say 11. A Wikiwand mirror says 12 and a 2023 article says 8; neither is supported officially. Chawngte, Sinlung, Sangau, Bungtlang South, Tlabung remain PROPOSED.

Nagaland.disagreement: Aggregator lists aimed at 2026 exams still say 16 (predate Meluri). Official sources use diacritics most users will not type, so both forms listed. The 'Frontier Nagaland' bill creates a territorial body, not a district.

Odisha.as_of: count stable since 1994; English spellings re-gazetted June 2026
Odisha.disagreement: Live spelling conflict: June 2026 gazette 'corrected' English spellings to Odia phonetics (Cuttack->Kataka, Balasore->Baleshwar, Khurda->Khordha...). odisha.gov.in uses the new forms; district NIC sites, LGD and census still use the conventional ones. Conventional forms kept canonical, gazette spellings as aliases.

Puducherry.disagreement: The UT's own portal (https://py.gov.in/districts, 12 Nov 2026) says it has two districts, Puducherry and Karaikal, with Mahe and Yanam as administrative units run by Regional Administrators. They are kept as four here because each is a geographically separate enclave (Mahe inside Kerala, Yanam inside Andhra Pradesh): folding them into Puducherry would lose the address information without misfiling anything. Treat Mahe and Yanam as regions, not revenue districts.
Puducherry.notes: Four separate enclaves: Puducherry and Karaikal inside Tamil Nadu, Mahe inside Kerala (Kannur), Yanam inside Andhra Pradesh. Pincode/state validation must not assume a Puducherry address sits in Tamil Nadu - Mahe is 673310, Yanam 533464.

Punjab.disagreement: punjab.gov.in's districts page is only a map image; official count of 23 confirmed via minesandgeology.punjab.gov.in. Anandpur Sahib is PROPOSED, not counted.

Rajasthan.as_of: 41 per gazette of 2024-12-30 dissolving 9 of the 2023 districts
Rajasthan.disagreement: Timeline: 33 -> 50 (Aug-Oct 2023) -> 41 (Dec 2024 dissolution of 9 districts and 3 divisions). The 9 dissolved names are parked as aliases on their ABSORBING district (Anupgarh->Sri Ganganagar, Dudu->Jaipur, Gangapur City->Sawai Madhopur, Jaipur Rural->Jaipur, Jodhpur Rural->Jodhpur, Kekri->Ajmer, Neem Ka Thana->Sikar, Sanchore->Jalore, Shahpura->Bhilwara) - these are absorbed former districts, not spelling variants. Scroll.in says 12 scrapped (counting 3 never-notified); gazette says 9. Mirrors still publish 50; the state statistics portal still publishes the pre-2023 list of 33. Verified the 41 names against the Rajasthan election dept BLO-links document.

Tamil Nadu.disagreement: Official TN sources disagree on romanisation (Kanyakumari/Kanniyakumari, Tiruvallur/Thiruvallur, Viluppuram/Villupuram, Kancheepuram/Kanchipuram) so both forms listed. Note Tirupathur (district) vs Tirupattur (its HQ town), and a separate unrelated Tirupattur in Sivaganga.

Telangana.disagreement: State portal and Wikipedia agree on 33 and on the names; they differ only on romanisation (Kumuram Bheem vs Komaram Bheem Asifabad, Rangareddy vs Ranga Reddy, Hanumakonda vs Hanamkonda).

Uttar Pradesh.disagreement: 'Kalyan Singh Nagar' announced 2025-10-31 but NOT gazetted; up.gov.in still lists 75. The Dec 2024 Maha Kumbh Mela district was temporary and already merged back. Do not add either.

Uttarakhand.disagreement: uk.gov.in timed out; count 13 agreed by all sources checked. Four 2011-announced districts (Yamunotri, Kotdwar, Ranikhet, Didihat) were never notified.

West Bengal.disagreement: 23 notified districts, confirmed 18 Nov 2026 against the LGD active-district feed (no creation since Paschim Bardhaman, 21 Apr 2017), the CEO West Bengal district list and the absence of any district website for an announced name. The 22 Jun 2026 budget announced Kolkata (as a full revenue district), Basirhat, Sundarbans, Jangipur and Arambagh; none is notified. Their names are parked as aliases on their parent districts, each parent verified at block level in LGD: Basirhat -> North 24 Parganas, Sundarban -> South 24 Parganas (Canning, Kakdwip), Jangipur -> Murshidabad, Arambagh -> Hooghly. 'Sundarban' is a known misfile risk: the region also covers North 24 Parganas blocks (Hingalganj, Sandeshkhali). The bare old-district names Midnapore and Bishnupur are deliberately not aliased: each is claimable by two current districts.
